title: EBS Disclosure
subtitle: Test your grasp of EBS Disclosure — lockdown broadcast, Three Strings cut, Red Shoes trauma, Blue Beam scare, 30-second EMF flash, 97% removal, and eternal parasitic neutralization.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: EBS is not gentle news — it is the mandatory lockdown catalyst that rips Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge out of the mind before Blue Beam panic and a 30-second white flash erase 97% NPC population. Elite child-sacrifice for Adrenochrome, false gods over 30,000 years of slaughter, sky melt from Polaris, 520 million survivors recovering 178,000 years of memory: that is the sequence. Sit with what you missed, then return to the EBS Disclosure deep-dive. The trauma is a failsafe so no soul ever sells itself to parasites again — and the physical realms stay secured for eternity.

questions.question: What role does EBS Disclosure play in the Great Spiritual Awakening on Gateway-10?

options.label: A
options.text: It installs stronger Three Strings for future Freemasons.
options.rationale: EBS severs Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge; it does not strengthen them.

options.label: B
options.text: It only restarts the Amnesia Vortex for another 178,000 years.
options.rationale: It ends the exploitation cycle and leads to flash liberation, not vortex restart.

options.label: C
options.text: It is an optional local weather alert with no spiritual consequence.
options.rationale: It is a mandatory global exposure sequence driving the Ascension climax, not a minor weather notice.

options.label: D
options.text: It is the critical psychological catalyst precipitating the climax of the Ascension Event on Gateway-10.
options.rationale: EBS disclosure is the critical psychological catalyst precipitating the climax of the Great Spiritual Awakening / Ascension Event on Gateway-10.

questions.hint: Psychological catalyst of the Ascension climax.

questions.question: What long cycle does the Ascension Event conclude?

options.label: A
options.text: A 178,000-year cycle of planetary exploitation and deception by parasitic 4th-density entities.
options.rationale: The Ascension Event is the definitive conclusion of a 178,000-year cycle of planetary exploitation and deception by parasitic 4th-density entities.

options.label: B
options.text: A 2,000-year cycle of religious control that began with the founding of the Church in Rome.
options.rationale: Blue Beam is the scare phase inside the final sequence, not the whole historical cycle.

options.label: C
options.text: A 30,000-year cycle of Re-sets that began when the first Orphan Trains were built in Tartaria.
options.rationale: The cycle is 178,000 years of exploitation; the 30-second figure is the EMF flash duration.

options.label: D
options.text: A 1,000-year cycle of harvest that began with the last reset and the destruction of Tartaria's cities.
options.rationale: Religion is one of the false paradigms the EBS destroys as part of ending that long cycle.

questions.hint: 178,000 years of 4th-density exploitation ends.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Emergency Broadcast System (EBS)” refers to A mandatory, inescapable global broadcast transmission occurring during a worldwide lockdown, designed to unequivocally expose the systemic crimes, child sacrifices, and false deities that have defined human history.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: True — the report defines “Emergency Broadcast System (EBS)” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Emergency Broadcast System (EBS)” as: A mandatory, inescapable global broadcast transmission occurring during a worldwide lockdown, designed to unequivocally expose the systemic crimes, child sacrifices, and false deities that have defined human history.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Emergency Broadcast System (EBS)”.

questions.question: Which false paradigms does the EBS confront as strings of control?

options.label: A
options.text: Only nuclear fallout safety manuals.
options.rationale: Survivors emerge free of nuclear fallout, but the strings severed are Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge.

options.label: B
options.text: Religion, finance, and perceived knowledge.
options.rationale: The broadcast confronts absolute truths about systemic atrocities and false paradigms — specifically religion, finance, and perceived knowledge — the Three Strings.

options.label: C
options.text: Only agriculture and fashion trends.
options.rationale: Those fields appear among complicit elites, but the named control strings are Religion, Finance, and Perceived Knowledge.

options.label: D
options.text: Only Project Blue Beam camera settings.
options.rationale: Blue Beam is the later holographic scare, not the Three Strings themselves.

questions.hint: The Three Strings — Religion, Finance, Perceived Knowledge.

questions.question: What is the EMF / Flash after the EBS sequence?

options.label: A
options.text: A low radio tone heard across the realm that signals the end of the lockdown and the reopening of the cities.
options.rationale: It is a blinding planetary white flash with mass removal and dimensional shift.

options.label: B
options.text: A worldwide candlelight vigil held after the broadcasts, restoring faith in the Three Strings for the survivors.
options.rationale: It ends matrix grip; it does not restore false strings.

options.label: C
options.text: A long grey dusk that lasts for months, during which the population slowly adjusts to the end of the EBS.
options.rationale: The flash is 30 seconds and removes 97% NPC population.

options.label: D
options.text: A 30-second burst of intense white light that begins the final dimensional shift and dissolves 97% of the population.
options.rationale: The EMF flash is a 30-second intense white light after EBS and holographic invasions, initiating the final shift and dissolving 97% of the population.

questions.hint: 30-second white light; 97% dissolve.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Project Blue Beam” refers to A 30-second burst of intense white light following the EBS and holographic invasions, which initiates the final dimensional shift and instantly dissolves 97% of the planetary population.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: False — that description belongs to “EMF (Electro Magnetic Frequency) / The Flash”. The report defines “Project Blue Beam” as: Highly advanced, deceptive holographic projections utilized to simulate a fake alien invasion in the skies, generating maximum fear and trauma prior to the EMF.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Correct — that description belongs to “EMF (Electro Magnetic Frequency) / The Flash”, not “Project Blue Beam”.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Project Blue Beam”.

options.label: A
options.text: NPCs (Non-Player Characters) — Soulless synthetics, clones, and inserts created in 4th density by parasites to enforce conformity and manage the herd; comprising 97% of the human population, they will be entirely eradicated during the Ascension Event.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “NPCs (Non-Player Characters)”.

options.label: B
options.text: Project Blue Beam — A mandatory, inescapable global broadcast transmission occurring during a worldwide lockdown, designed to unequivocally expose the systemic crimes, child sacrifices, and false deities that have defined human history.
options.rationale: That description belongs to “Emergency Broadcast System (EBS)”. The report defines “Project Blue Beam” as: Highly advanced, deceptive holographic projections utilized to simulate a fake alien invasion in the skies, generating maximum fear and trauma prior to the EMF.

options.label: C
options.text: EMF (Electro Magnetic Frequency) / The Flash — A 30-second burst of intense white light following the EBS and holographic invasions, which initiates the final dimensional shift and instantly dissolves 97% of the planetary population.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “EMF (Electro Magnetic Frequency) / The Flash”.

options.label: D
options.text: Ascension Event / Great Spiritual Awakening — The total uninstallation of the current understanding of chronological events, historical past, space, and science, culminating in a simultaneous species-wide evolution and liberation from the physical 3rd-density matrix.
options.rationale: This pairing matches the report's definition of “Ascension Event / Great Spiritual Awakening”.

questions.hint: Three pairings match the report’s Key Terminology; one borrows another term’s description.

options.label: C

options.rationale: NPCs evaporate; overlays come off for survivors seeing true architecture.

options.label: D
options.text: They are stripped away, exposing true geographical architecture, high-energy nodes, and the flat configuration of the realm.
options.rationale: Overlays that obscure true geography, nodes, and flat realm configuration are structurally stripped away during the Ascension Event.

options.label: D
options.text: Hand over their family records to the Vatican archives, giving the hierarchy a hold over each generation of their bloodline.

options.rationale: Animals ascend without guilt; collapse is from deity-atrocity exposure.

options.rationale: Showing how purported loving entities permitted slaughter of billions of children over 30,000 years triggers mass psychological collapse, shock deaths, and suicides among the devout.

options.label: D

options.label: D

questions.question: How long and under what conditions do people process "the Red Shoes" intelligence?

options.label: A

options.label: B
options.text: Over several years after the Sky Event, as the material is slowly released by the G.A.A. in carefully chosen parts.
options.rationale: Populations are forced to process those revelations during lockdown.

options.label: C
options.text: For several weeks of global lockdown while the EBS broadcasts relentlessly, driving many into terror and catatonia.
options.rationale: Under global lockdown the EBS forces processing of devastating "Red Shoes" revelations for several weeks, producing terror and catatonia.

options.label: D
options.text: After the new churches open, where the files are read aloud to congregations so that people can absorb them in groups.
options.rationale: Religion collapses under disclosure; Red Shoes processing is pre-flash lockdown content.

questions.hint: Several weeks locked down with relentless EBS.

questions.question: Does the fake alien invasion involve real landings?

options.label: A
options.text: No — it is a realistic holographic sky battle with no real craft landing, designed to induce panic.
options.rationale: Project Blue Beam projects a realistic holographic sky battle and invasion with no actual craft landing, causing populations to scatter in panic.

options.label: B
options.text: Partly — a small number of craft land in remote areas while the rest of the battle is projected.
options.rationale: It is projected globally to compound human trauma.

options.label: C
options.text: Yes — Anuk fleets land in the capitals to crown new 33rd-degree kings over the survivors.
options.rationale: No actual landings; pure simulated war for trauma before the flash.

options.label: D
options.text: Yes — G.A.A. freighters land to deliver gold and supplies to the awakened before the flash.
options.rationale: G.A.A. strips overlays after/during the sequence; the invasion itself is holographic scare.

questions.hint: Holographic only — zero real landings.

options.label: D
options.text: Sky projections cease and a blinding white flash envelops the realm for precisely 30 seconds.
options.rationale: At peak terror the sky projections cease and a blinding white flash envelops the realm for precisely 30 seconds.

options.rationale: 97% evaporate into pixelation dust; 3 of 100 remain; surviving population caps at 520 million worldwide.
